_meta.title: l'instant en vol — the storm caught in flight (front 32a) + the species genome of the ladder (front 32b)
_meta.lane: scratch-ring28, RELEASE+SMMSTORE_V2 rebuild (ring-32 build), EMU lane restored after
_meta.instrument: QEMU -d int,cpu_reset passive per-exception logging — no gdb, no breakpoints, no watchpoints, no freezing: the observer that defused the storm in ring 31b is absent by design

32a_in_flight.question: the frozen pre-fatal instant was named uncapturable by per-delivery freezing (ring 31 residual, the observer effect) — can the fatal geometry be captured WITHOUT freezing?
32a_in_flight.answer: YES — passive -d int logging records the full fatal ladder in flight; the storm fires under logging; the ladder, the chain step, and the crossing are all measured

fatal_geometry_measured.chain_step_per_delivery: -0x660 (measured on every tail step of every storm)
fatal_geometry_measured.fatal_site: 0x1f970cac = CpuDxe+0xDCAC = the fxsave in the exception entry stub
fatal_geometry_measured.error_code: e=0003 (supervisor write, PRESENT) in all three

cascade_hangs_measured.definition: the five non-storm boots never completed DXE in 60-90 s: serial ends at coreboot's 'Jumping to boot code', the stub never speaks, the HPET cascade stays engaged until the kill
cascade_hangs_measured.reading: the cascade oscillates: chained re-deliveries descend 0x660 per step, partial unwinds recover toward the band top (~0x4ed8xxx — exactly the band ring 31b saw live under freezing); a run can go 513 deep and RECOVER (boot 3); the fatal boots crossed on the 543rd consecutive re-delivery

32a_in_flight.mechanism_unified: the un-EOI'd level-triggered HPET cascade (ring 29) re-delivers into the still-executing handler; every chained re-delivery consumes exactly 0x660 of stack (now measured per-step in flight, was inferred frozen); between chains, partial unwinds produce the oscillation; the walk's fate — fatal crossing vs indefinite oscillation — is decided per delivery by TCG scheduling (ring 30a's race); the crossing happens when the exception stub's 0x3A8 push from the last legal landing dips below the SEC-carved moat 0x4e00000, and the fxsave writes its buffer at moat-0xA0 on the dominant residue
corrections: ring 31b's 'deterministic storm' label is BUILD-SCOPED: the ring-32 rebuild (same recipe) storms at 3/8, not 100% — determinism belonged to the ring-31 build, not to the lane

the 'byte-identical CR2' claim (rings 29/31, 0x4DFFF60) is QUANTIZED-NOT-UNIQUE: the ring-32 build produces three crossing residues {moat-0xA0, moat-0xD0, moat-0x180}; moat-0xA0 is the dominant one and is what rings 29/31 observed — small-sample coincidence on the dominant residue, now registered as such
the SMMSTORE lane NEVER completes a boot: 'green' in this lane = indefinite cascade oscillation (a hang), not a completed DXE — the lane's only two end states are fatal crossing or hang
32a_in_flight.residual_closed: the frozen pre-fatal instant — ring 31's registered residual — is CLOSED: passive in-flight logging captures the entire fatal ladder without freezing; the observer effect applies to freezing (ring 31b), not to passive logging (ring 32)

32b_genome.question: can nine rings of scattered registers be fused into ONE queryable species catalog of the ASUS ladder — the ladder genome — with zero downloads?
32b_genome.answer: YES — 330 species ever touched by a frontier event, with birth/death rungs, move counts, body-hash chains, and armor flags (lab/vendor-genome.json)
inputs: vendor-churn-atlas.json (9 frontiers, born/dead/moved + from/to hash chains)

headline_numbers.quiet_pair_3802_3810: born=0 dead=0 moved=45 (ring 23 confirmed at genome level)
headline_numbers.top_movers: 26 species moved at all 8 frontiers (the AGESA chronic family)

genome_level_reads: SbRomArmorSmm (51080191) moves=0: ONE body across 4.5 years — ring 19's finding now exact at genome granularity
the armor quartet is NOT uniformly frozen: PrepareWhiteListSmm and FlashSmiDxe moved twice, FlashSmiSmm and the 89BE47F4 freeform once, SbRomArmorSmm never
the ladder's churn spine: 98 species moved exactly 5 times, 54 chronic movers (6+), 26 at every frontier
births are EXACTLY the security waves: five at 3802, two at 4604, zero elsewhere; deaths are EXACTLY the two legacy smm_driver retirements (4202, 4402)
32b_genome.day0_service: any GUID found in the day-0 dump can be placed instantly: birth rung, death rung, move count, hash chain, armor flags — the genome is the lookup table the day-0 checklist was missing

recipes.lane_switch_smmstore_ring32: cd scratch-ring28/coreboot && cp .config .config.ring32-emu-backup && sed -i 's/^# CONFIG_SMMSTORE_V2 is not set/CONFIG_SMMSTORE_V2=y/' .config && make olddefconfig && source ../env.sh && UPDATED_SUBMODULES=1 make -j$(nproc)
recipes.lane_restore_emu_ring32: cp .config.ring31-emu-backup .config && cp ../coreboot.rom.ring31-emu-backup build/coreboot.rom (sanity: ec=0, CHAIN OK)
recipes.in_flight_boot: ./fw32_inflight.sh <id> <timeout_s> — QEMU -d int,cpu_reset -D int-fw32-<id>.log, serial to serial-fw32-inflight<id>.log, no gdb
recipes.ladder_parse: python3 fw32_parse.py int-fw32-<id>.log — tail ladder, SP steps, convergence depth, longest same-IP run, fatal geometry vs moat

honesty: n=8 boots, one build: the storm rate 3/8 carries a wide binomial interval; only the ring-32 build was measured in flight — rings 29/31 numbers stay scoped to their builds
-d int logging itself was not A/B-measured as a perturber in this ring (ring 30's no-log EMU boots do not transfer to this lane); the in-flight rates are logging-conditioned by construction
the 'consecutive at RET' depth counts logged landings, which include partial unwinds between chains — it is not a monotone nesting depth

the genome covers only species TOUCHED by frontier events; the never-touched static core is not enumerable from registers (per-rung GUID sets were computed in-session and not persisted) — registered in the genome's honesty block
the 665-entry GUID-name join map body was never persisted (map_size only); names join in only at the armor quartet
